title: What a Dining Plan Meets on a Resort Lodging Folio
content:
A dining plan meets what a Resort Lodging party put on the folio at the collective's tables. Two things are read: the dining charges standing on the reservation's folio, and the household's dining plans under Mountain Dining Plans, for their standing, the season they are held for and the balance loaded on them.

Where a dining plan stands active for the season of the stay and the balance loaded on it reaches the dining charges standing on the folio, those dining charges are met from the plan.

Where a dining plan stands active for that season and the balance loaded on it falls short of those dining charges, the balance loaded on the plan is met from it.

Where no dining plan stands active for that season, nothing is met from a plan.

| Dining plan standing active for the season | The balance loaded against the dining charges standing | What is met |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | the balance reaches the charges | the dining charges standing on the folio |
| yes | the balance falls short of the charges | the balance loaded on the plan |
| no | — | nothing |

### Both sides of the boundary (hypothetical folios carrying 420.00 USD of dining charges)

A dining plan standing active for the season of the stay carrying a loaded balance of 420.00 USD reaches those charges exactly, so the whole 420.00 USD of dining charges is met from the plan; reaching them is enough and the balance need not exceed them.

A dining plan standing active for that season carrying a loaded balance of 150.00 USD falls short, so 150.00 USD is met from it.

A household whose only dining plan was held for another season has no plan standing active for the season of the stay, and nothing is met from a plan.
